additional_concerns: The pending-application exclusion faithfully implements the question's proposed transition reading. The source expressly preserves the existing process; it does not independently establish a permanent exclusion from relief after withdrawal, replacement or later disposition of an application.
The formula uses the explicit implementation date. The issuance date is absent, so the relationship between 'immediate effect' and 28 November 2025 remains unresolved.
The supplied dependency IDs have no descriptive mapping or source content. Neither can safely be assigned to the FAQs, forms or another authority.

Home-jurisdiction compliance and the novelty, complexity and possible local-policy classifications are supplied inputs, not implemented legal assessments. Detailed eligibility remains dependent on missing guidance and applicable home-jurisdiction requirements.

A false result establishes only failure of the selected relief conditions. It does not establish an independent prior-approval obligation, non-compliance or exemption from notification and post-vetting.
No separate home-regulator-supervision condition should be inferred from the introductory purpose statement without further authority.
